# Tastemakers Collective

> Custom menus for every event and every diet.

Tastemakers Collective is a Los Angeles catering and events company. We cook for music festivals, corporate events, weddings and private dinners. Over a decade cooking for artist green rooms, VIP areas and staff at music festivals.

## What we do

- Wedding catering: Custom menus and full service for weddings. Plated, family style, buffet or stations. https://www.tastemakerscollective.us/weddings
- Corporate catering: Office lunches, meetings and company events in Los Angeles. https://www.tastemakerscollective.us/corporate
- Event catering: Catering for private parties, celebrations and milestones. https://www.tastemakerscollective.us/events
- Festival vending and event hospitality: Food vending, staff meals and artist hospitality at festivals and large events. https://www.tastemakerscollective.us/vending
- Drop-off catering: Drop-off catering for offices and gatherings. https://www.tastemakerscollective.us/order

## Contact

- Phone: (213) 293-8518
- Email: hello@tastemakerscollective.us
- Service area: Los Angeles

## Permits and insurance

- Permitted by LA County Public Health.
- Prepared in a permitted commercial kitchen.
- $2M general liability insurance.
- ServSafe certified manager.
- Certificate of insurance available on request.
